issues.title: `set_html` builds markup from an interpolated value in frontend/app.howl
issues.summary: A call to `set_html` assembles HTML containing an interpolated value and no escape function appears in the surrounding expression.
issues.remediation: Route every interpolated value through the artifact's escape function, or set text content instead of markup.

issues.title: `esc` does not escape the single quote but is used inside a JavaScript string literal
issues.summary: `esc` escapes ", &, <, > and not the single quote (defined at frontend/mission_view.howl:64). At frontend/mission_view.howl:134 its output is placed inside a single-quoted JavaScript string in an event-handler attribute. The HTML parser decodes the attribute before JavaScript parses it, so a single quote in the value terminates the string literal and everything after it becomes code. Escaping the double quote prevents breaking out of the attribute; it does not prevent breaking out of the string.

tton type=\"button\" class=\"mission-row s-" (call esc st) "\""
              " onclick=\"window.open_mission('" (call esc id) "')\">") ""))
issues.remediation: Escape the single quote in the escape function, or stop embedding values in handler attributes and bind the listener in code instead. Escaping for HTML text is not sufficient for a JavaScript context.
